description: Outbrain performance for a date range (from / to YYYY-MM-DD, or days, default 7, up to a year), by campaign (default) or by date (a row a day): spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, average CPC, conversions, CPA and conversion value, with totals. campaignId narrows it to one campaign. Reports run 10-30 minutes behind and allow 10 reads a minute per marketer. Read-only, free.
name: outbrain_ads_report
title: Outbrain performance
